title: The Mountain Collision That Cooled Our Planet
description: Discover how the tectonic collision that formed the Himalayas pulled carbon from the air and triggered a global ice age.
instagram_caption:
The tallest mountains on Earth actually act as a giant carbon vacuum. 🏔️ Discover how the rise of the Himalayas fundamentally re-shaped our planet's climate and triggered an ancient ice age.

#Himalayas #EarthScience #ClimateHistory #WondersOfNature #Geology

segments.narration: The tallest mountains on Earth act as a giant vacuum, actively pulling greenhouse gases directly out of our atmosphere.
Acidic rain dissolved these newly exposed stones, washing massive carbon particles into the oceans where tiny marine organisms locked it permanently onto the seafloor.

segments.narration: This global carbon drain starved the atmosphere of heat, triggering a massive drop in temperature that plunged our planet into an ice age.

segments.narration: This ancient shift created the stable, livable climate we enjoy today, a cooling process still fueled by modern seasonal monsoons.
